description.en: Preserved-frond-only Matonidium-inspired teaching organ, with thin radiating axes and rounded subtriangular pinnules. Connections and exact layout are teaching assembly: organic connection was not preserved in the cited Matonidium sp. analogy. No tree, roots or whole living crown.
description.zh: 仅保存蕨叶器官的Matonidium启发教学展示，具细放射轴及圆端亚三角羽片。连接和布局属教学整合：引用的Matonidium sp.类比未保存完整有机连接。不添加干、根或整株活体冠。
